# `work` pack

<!-- Generated by `REDACT_BLESS=1 cargo test` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Work names: Azure DevOps organisation, project and repo names; your own Azure hosts; tenant, subscription and company names; Google Cloud project IDs. Off by default

| Rule | Hides as | What it finds | Hidden everywhere after |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| `ado-org` | `[ORG-…]` | dev.azure.com/&lt;org&gt; | yes |
| `ado-project-url` | `[PROJECT-…]` | dev.azure.com/&lt;org&gt;/&lt;project&gt; | yes |
| `ado-repo-url` | `[REPO-…]` | .../_git/&lt;repo&gt; | when it reads as a name |
| `ado-org-ssh` | `[ORG-…]` | The org in an Azure Repos SSH URL: ssh.dev.azure.com:v3/&lt;org&gt;/... | yes |
| `ado-project-ssh` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The project in an Azure Repos SSH URL: ssh.dev.azure.com:v3/&lt;org&gt;/&lt;project&gt;/... | yes |
| `ado-org-visualstudio` | `[ORG-…]` | The org in the older &lt;org&gt;.visualstudio.com Azure DevOps URLs | yes |
| `ado-project-visualstudio` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The project in &lt;org&gt;.visualstudio.com/&lt;project&gt;/ URLs | yes |
| `ado-org-artifacts` | `[ORG-…]` | The org in Azure Artifacts feed URLs: pkgs.dev.azure.com/&lt;org&gt;/ | yes |
| `ado-org-artifacts-vs` | `[ORG-…]` | The org in older Azure Artifacts feed URLs: &lt;org&gt;.pkgs.visualstudio.com | yes |
| `work-item-project` | `[PROJECT-…]` | A work item's TeamProject, and the first part of AreaPath and IterationPath | yes |
| `project-record` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The name in an az devops project record | yes |
| `repo-record` | `[REPO-…]` | The name in an az repos record | when it reads as a name |
| `dataverse-env` | `[RESOURCE-…]` | &lt;name&gt;.crm11.dynamics.com | when it reads as a name |
| `web-app` | `[RESOURCE-…]` | &lt;name&gt;.azurewebsites.net and &lt;name&gt;.powerappsportals.com | when it reads as a name |
| `azure-resource` | `[RESOURCE-…]` | Key Vault, storage, SQL, Service Bus and container registry names | when it reads as a name |
| `tenant-name` | `[ORG-…]` | &lt;name&gt;.sharepoint.com and &lt;name&gt;.onmicrosoft.com | yes |
| `tenant-display-name` | `[ORG-…]` | tenantDisplayName: usually the organisation's own name | yes |
| `subscription-name` | `[RESOURCE-…]` | The name of a subscription in an az account record | when it reads as a name |
| `graph-company` | `[PROFILE-…]` | companyName: the employer | yes |
| `project-id-field` | `[PROJECT-…]` | project_id and projectId in a service account key file or API output | yes |
| `project-path` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The project in a resource path: projects/&lt;id&gt;/... | yes |
| `project-flag` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The project after --project (gcloud) | yes |

## Allowed values

These exact values are left alone even when a rule above would hide them: they are settings or public names, not secrets. Only the value itself is allowed, never what sits next to it.

`AzureCloud`
